title: Detecting and Classifying Malevolent Dialogue Responses: Taxonomy, Data and Methodology

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a Hierarchical Malevolent Dialogue Taxonomy (HMDT) that explicitly defines a 'Stereotype' category (subdivided into Negative Intergroup Attitude and Phobia towards culture, age, gender, ethnicity, religion, and hierarchy) and evaluating various neural text classifiers (e.g., BERT, CNN, RNN, GCN) on their ability to accurately detect and classify these biased responses in a crowdsourced multi-turn dialogue dataset.
